_note: Hotel candidates for the sheet, found 2026-09-09 by reading guides and blogs - NOT booking engines. Supersedes the 2026-09-07 pass, which enumerated the Hotels.com typeahead and so recorded what an OTA sells rather than what anyone rates.
_method: SERP-first per data/serp/README.md: run the search a reader runs, with the word blog to pull independents above the mastheads. 20 sources across three corpora (data/serp/hotels.txt, hotels-budget.txt, hostels.txt), fetched and extracted by the normal consensus pipeline. Booking.com, Hotels.com, Expedia, Tripadvisor, Agoda and Hostelworld are excluded on sight - they rank by inventory and commission, so a listing there is not a recommendation.
_hotelsComRule: Hotels.com is a VALIDATOR, never a source. Before a candidate becomes a row, confirm it exists and is bookable there, because a property that is not cannot carry an affiliate link. NOT YET DONE: uk.hotels.com/api/v4/typeahead returns HTTP 429 with a CAPTCHA challenge to curl. Needs the browser, as the URL-resolution pass did in September.
_deadSource: Travel and Leisure returned HTTP 402 (paywall). Not retried.
_knownFilterGap: The area filter uses HOODS from scripts/london-geo.mjs, which has Camden Town but not bare Camden, so Camden slipped through as a property and was removed by hand. Worth adding the short forms.
